sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases water elemental attack by 18 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases water elemental attack buff limit by 8 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
